g.text: FST-050 - Consented loopback proxy and website decisions
close Brave within 60 seconds (no forced exit)
close all Brave windows, including dev UI
launch native Brave with PAC + verification address
PAC routes traffic; policy stays in the proxy to avoid PAC cache delays.
validate authority, framing and resource bounds
read committed consent, running unexpired WORK, rule
most-specific enabled domain decision or none
HTTPS CONNECT tunnels preserve encrypted TLS bytes.
No certificates, TLS interception, telemetry or payload persistence.
Independent lease restores settings after disconnect.
Restart recovers journals; concurrent user changes are preserved.
Native browser/OS verification is required before claiming support.
